g.text: CAD core — ensure geometry once, request evidence repeatedly
validate / freeze inputs; compute build key
Build key: source, build parameters, declared inputs, native versions/settings.
Views, annotations, metrics and exports do not change geometry identity.
Source-based evaluate remains a convenience that ensures and queries in one call.
restore native geometry without executing source
staged native bundle / feature map, or build error
freeze native snapshot + provenance, if available
load available native geometry; never run generated code here
live geometry_handle + geometry digest, or diagnostics
ensure result + handle / native snapshot reference
validate live handle; pin immutable geometry
JSON sidecars + inline labels from shared annotation records
computed values, units, targets, criteria, outcomes
release query pin; retain geometry for another request
finalize result.json atomically after completed files
release cached state once no query pins it
Handles are stable while live; expiry/restart is explicit, never a hidden source rebuild.
Restore a retained native snapshot to obtain a new handle; query state never mutates geometry.
Each query gets its own immutable result. Failed checks preserve useful evidence; STEP is optional.
Titles appear at each view's top-left when inline annotations are selected; JSON keeps view/camera coordinates.
No chat, ACP or MCP dependency inside this core. Message grouping belongs to the wrapper.
Review draft: docs/M-CAD.md, M-CAD-1-20 and M-CAD-31-36. Examples: cad/examples/cylinder/.
One-shot CLI can read a native bundle; retained local runtimes/harnesses can use live handles.
Separate diagram cad-handoff covers transfer, durable operations and publication.
Local process boundaries are a development stage; Docker later enforces isolation (TRD-25, TRD-37).
